# Third-party software distributed with Z-Link

## ODF Scan for Zotero — `zotero-odf-scan-v3.2.1.xpi`

A verbatim, unmodified copy of the plugin, hosted here so that Z-Link users can
download it in one click rather than hunting for it. Z-Link does not require the
plugin to run; it is what turns the Scannable Cite markers in Z-Link's output
into live Zotero citations.

The complete corresponding source for this binary is the upstream repository
linked above, which is where the licence text ships as well.

The AGPL permits this redistribution. Nothing here modifies the plugin — verify
with the SHA-256 above if you want to be sure the copy you downloaded is the one
upstream published.

### Keeping it current

To update, drop the newer `.xpi` in this directory, refresh the version, hash
and any changed author list above, and update the filename in the download link
in `web/index.html`. Check the new release's `manifest.json` for the minimum
Zotero version, since the help text states it.
